title: MATERIAL typed callback retention bounds
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound adapter-owned typed MATERIAL callback copies over the dx_data container lifetime
Keep typed MATERIAL accounting distinct from the existing raw DXF carrier receipt
Make incomplete or over-budget typed capture fail closed before DXF output publication
Add generated fast checks for exact admission, copy independence, sticky refusal, and destination preservation

controls: Logical retained bytes include table-entry state, the typed material name/description, and opaque DWG body bytes
Exact-fit record and byte limits admit a generated MATERIAL callback copy
Over-budget record/byte attempts refuse copies and leave aggregate counters unchanged
Capture failure remains sticky, is reflected by the material receipt, and prevents replacement of an existing output
implementation.limitations: Logical payload accounting does not measure allocator capacity or RSS. The bound does not qualify the incomplete MATERIAL property grammar, raw carrier replay, object graph closure, DWG-origin serialization, or native consumer acceptance.

localEvidence: The previous addMaterial callback copied to dx_data::materials without adapter-owned aggregate record/byte admission; the raw MATERIAL companion has separate accounting.
The generated test exercises only in-memory objects and a temporary destination sentinel; no persistent or downloaded drawing fixture was added.

planImpact.existingOwnerRefined: 7S.2c typed persistent TABLES/OBJECTS callback capture census
planImpact.remainingCensus: LTYPE, DIMSTYLE, BLOCK_RECORD, and LAYOUT direct callback stores remain to audit.
